entities.name: Temken
entities.description: Elven mage from Argoth who gathered Survivors of the Brothers' War to find a new home.

entities.name: Gwenna
entities.description: Survivor plagued by guilt over her role in the Sylex Blast, who trapped the shadow inside herself.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Lost homeland of Temken and the Survivors.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Spirit of the land whose magic remains.

entities.name: Shadow of the bayou
entities.description: Malevolent evil spirit that fed on despair in the dark bayou.

events.summary: Temken meets Gwenna in a dark bayou and shows her Gaea's magic remains in the land.
events.quote: Temken showed Gwenna that Gaea was not dead

events.summary: The swamp's shadow attacks Temken, who is guided to Gwenna's village of Survivors.
events.quote: Weakened, but not defeated, Temken was guided to Gwenna's village of Survivors

events.summary: Gwenna traps the shadow inside herself so the villagers can leave with Temken, who absolves her of her sins.
events.quote: Gwenna stopped it, trapping it inside herself

events.summary: Temken leads the Survivors away from the bayou forever.
events.quote: Temken then led the larger band of Survivors away from the bayou forever.

relations.note: Plagued by guilt over her role in it.
relations.quote: was plagued by guilt over her role in the disaster
